purpose: Dedicated-host equal-work CPU and upstream-CUDA release characterization on Cura

invariants.resolution_policy: Synthetic fixtures retain their declared 1 m cells. Licensed real sparse/urban/vegetation fixtures retain native source resolution (currently 2 m windows); no resampling is allowed for benchmark admission.
invariants.requested_outputs: UTCI plus all ten save flags enabled, including promised legacy SVF ZIP/NPZ
invariants.numerical_policy: unchanged; every artifact and intermediate prerequisite must pass before a timing contributes to a claim

required_real_scene_matrix.policy: Licensed real scenes augment synthetic families and retain native resolution.
required_real_scene_matrix.completion_gate: All three licensed scenes have provenance/license records, native-resolution fixture hashes, density inventories, original-upstream CPU/candidate numerical admission, and complete valid trials in every declared regime.

plans.all_on: all ten save flags true, including charged legacy SVF ZIP/NPZ where promised
plans.default: omit save overrides and record the exact public defaults
plans.all_off: all ten save flags false while retaining every intermediate required by the physical model

required_output_plan_matrix.completion_gate: Every workload/plan/regime/system cell has exact effective kwargs, equal requested work across systems, artifact-contract verification appropriate to that plan, and retained failures.

one_step.gate: Record unchanged upstream outcome, including the characterized failure if reproduced; candidate behavior is compared but the case cannot replace a full-day result.

full_day.coverage: all required synthetic and real end-to-end workloads

multi_day_state.forcing_policy: repeat the frozen 24-step forcing without resetting carried state
multi_day_state.gate: Compare every carried surface-temperature/delay field after every timestep and restart boundary under unchanged numerical gates; timing is reported separately from TIFF end-to-end claims.

required_timeline_matrix.completion_gate: One-step outcomes, all 24-step end-to-end cells, and the complete 72-step chronological state comparison are present and distinctly labeled.

additional_diagnostic_workloads.policy: diagnostic only; exclude from end-to-end speedup claims

systems.completion_synchronization: synchronize before timed workflow body after initialization and after workflow/output completion

baseline_selection: Report upstream CPU default separately. For each workload/regime, primary CPU baseline is the lowest median among all five predeclared valid upstream CPU configurations. Never select across workloads after aggregating.

pairing.order: randomize systems within each workload/regime/repetition; independent process for every trial
pairing.failure_policy: retain timeout, OOM, numerical failure, and unavailable records in schedule and aggregates

cache_regimes.first_use: fresh process, private empty compiled/JIT cache, absent geometry cache, imports/JIT/I/O and all requested exports timed
cache_regimes.compiled_geometry_cold: fresh process, hash-verified precompiled cache, absent geometry cache, all requested exports timed
cache_regimes.geometry_warm: fresh process, separately generated and hash-validated backend-native geometry cache, cache loading and all requested outputs timed
cache_regimes.os_page_cache: observe and record; do not label cold unless the host administrator supplies a valid cache-drop procedure

resource_policy.disk_preflight: required free bytes >= estimated scene copy + estimated outputs + estimated cache + estimated evidence + 10 GiB reserve
resource_policy.trial_retention: retain logs, manifests, measurements, comparisons and hashes; after verified download, delete task-created scene/output/cache trees one trial at a time
resource_policy.abort_policy: record resource failure; never reduce resolution, patches, timesteps, rays, vegetation, outputs, or logical work

measured_preflight.interpretation: Input preparation only. 3600 all-on is rejected at current free space under the conservative uncompressed estimate; do not shrink workload.

claim_policy.cpu_comparison: candidate_cpu_1 and candidate_cpu_36 versus selected strongest upstream CPU and separately versus upstream default
claim_policy.cuda_comparison: upstream CUDA is a separate system configuration; report crossovers without making CPU-beats-GPU a release gate

freeze_requirements: Bind this draft, parent protocol, harnesses, kwargs manifests, source trees, environments and every fixture inventory by SHA-256 before execution.

Bind the prepared 1024/2048 repeated/dense/vegetation fixtures and 3600 repeated fixture by recorded SHA-256; resolve the unchanged P7 generator rejection of dense/vegetation 3600 before adding those families, without substituting a smaller size.
Prove original upstream CPU, original upstream CUDA and candidate artifact agreement under unchanged comparison_v1 gates for each admitted fixture.
Record CPU affinity, frequency governor, NUMA placement, storage mount, GPU clocks/power/temperature and competing load for every trial.
Measure and freeze per-workload fixture, output, geometry-cache, JIT and evidence footprint estimates before scheduling any trial.
Resolve and lock an actually installable Torch 2.14.0 CUDA build and CUDA runtime compatible with driver 550.144.03 before admitting upstream_cuda.
release_matrix_completion_gate: Synthetic size/density matrix complete, including every declared first-use cell.
All three native-resolution licensed real-scene matrices complete; they are never replaced by synthetic cases.
Default, all-off and all-on output matrices complete.
One-step, 24-step and 72-step state matrices complete in their declared evidence classes.
Upstream default CPU, predeclared tuned CPU configurations, candidate one-thread/36-core and upstream CUDA are all measured or explicitly labeled unavailable/failed with evidence.
No performance aggregate includes a numerically invalid cell or weakens comparison_v1, the 12 GiB RSS limit, physical work, artifacts, or cache rules.

compatibility_gap.reason: unchanged prepare_p7_fixtures.py rejects sizes not divisible by 32; 3600 % 32 = 16
compatibility_gap.policy: do not substitute 3584 or modify frozen generator without protocol review
